column1: # Shared flags-file cases, run against BOTH readers of the per-event flags file:
#   go    = internal/catalog (flags_test.go: TestFlagsFileParity) — the authority on what is scored
# Both use the real challenges/ catalog. Every input that a side accepts must yield exactly
# expected.tsv on that side, so an input both accept is read identically by both.
# Rows where the verdicts differ are the known, fixed list of divergences (all are
# "scoreboard accepts, planting-side pre-check refuses"). The opposite direction must stay empty.
